battle.name: 猶他戰爭
battle.theater: 大鹽湖谷地與瓦薩奇山脈北麓
battle.brief: 一八五七年四月，聯邦政府以猶他領地廢除聯邦法律、私設民兵為由，派出約二千五百名正規軍西進。布賴翰·楊退往密蘇里河，聯邦軍於一八五八年七月二十六日無一槍一彈進入鹽湖城。全役沒有會戰，只在堡壘、缺口與遠程砲火之間周旋；線膛砲的射程優勢自頭到尾沒有決定過任何一場勝負。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰一方是美利堅合眾國聯邦政府。猶他領地設於一八五〇年，隸屬聯邦，總督由白宮任命，聯邦從不承認摩門教會對地方行政的實際掌控。一八五七年四月六日，總統詹姆斯·布坎南簽署命令，組建直屬陸軍部「猶他部」的遠征軍，由上校詹姆斯·卡爾頓率領，約二千五百名正規軍自東部與中部各州調集，配屬騎兵、步兵與砲兵連；另徵募加利福尼亞與內華達的騎兵義勇隊約七百五十人，於一八五七年秋越過內華達山脈進入大鹽湖盆地。遠征的後勤與車隊由摩門手推車公司以手推車與騾牛承擔，自堪薩斯城一路運補。與聯邦同時在草原上游蕩的還有肖肖尼與派尤特各部落的戰士，目標是聯邦的牛群與彈藥車隊，構成與本戰爭平行的另一條戰線。另一方是猶他領地的摩門教政權。名義上的領地總督為布賴翰·楊，但立法、行政與武力指揮多由教會掌握；民兵由丹尼爾·威爾斯中將統率，以色列·卡特勒、艾薩克·切斯等人分領各部，防守大鹽湖的堡壘線在一八五八年交由亨利·謝爾伍德主持。猶他並非國家，其武力是領民兵、教區武裝與城鄉巡邏隊；聯邦在法理上視之為叛亂，教方則解釋為護教與自衛。雙方都清楚正面會戰對己方不利，這一點反而成了日後收手的條件。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the government of the United States. The Territory of Utah, created in 1850, was a federal territory whose governor was appointed from Washington, and the federal government never recognised the actual control exercised over local administration by the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. On 6 April 1857 President James Buchanan signed the order creating the Utah Expedition under the direct authority of the War Department. Colonel James H. Carleton led it, drawing roughly 2,500 regulars from the eastern and midwestern states with cavalry, infantry and artillery companies attached; a further force of about 750 mounted volunteers was recruited in California and Nevada and crossed the Sierra Nevada into the Great Salt Lake basin in the autumn of 1857. The logistics of the column fell to the Mormon handcart company, which moved supplies by handcart and mule train out of Kansas City. Sharing the same plains were the war bands of the Shoshone and the Paiute, whose quarry was the federal cattle herds and ammunition wagons; their struggle formed a second front running in parallel with the war itself. The other side was the Mormon government of the Utah Territory. The nominal territorial governor was Brigham Young, but legislation, administration and the direction of force rested largely with the Church. The militia was under Lieutenant General Daniel H. Wells, with Israel Cutler, Isaac Chase and others commanding parts of it, while the defence of the Great Salt Lake, the line of earthworks known as the Fortifications, was handed to Henry G. Sherwood in 1858. Utah was not a state: its armed force was a territorial militia made up of ward and settlement companies and patrol detachments. In federal law the conflict was the suppression of rebellion; to the Church it was the defence of the faith. Both sides understood that a general engagement would be ruinous for them, and that shared conviction became the ground for a settlement later on.
people: 聯邦方面，總統詹姆斯·布坎南是整場遠征的推手。他以「摩門問題」危及西部領地安全為由簽署調兵令，又在猶他領地中止人身保護令，把聯邦司法管轄與軍隊推進綁在一起，使這次行軍看來不像入侵而更像執行法律。首任指揮官是詹姆斯·卡爾頓上校，他主持了一八五七年春天的長途進軍與橫越大鹽湖沙漠的行程，也因指揮作風與補給失誤在次年春天被解職；一八五八年三月由阿爾伯特·辛西·約翰斯頓准將接任，此人穩住了同年的僵局並在一八五九年的遠征中主持大局，最終在夏伊戰役中陣亡。加利福尼亞與內華達的騎兵義勇隊由商界與城鎮人口組成，紀律與政治立場都不齊，卡爾頓與後來的指揮部花了不少力氣安撫這支隊伍。猶他方面的核心是布賴翰·楊。他身兼領地總督與教會領袖，主持大局的方式是先安排替代人手再退場：一八五八年四月收到聯邦的離境令後，他最初抗命，五月仍退出鹽湖城前往密蘇里河沿岸，把談判的主動權交給副手，再由丹尼爾·威爾斯中將出面與約翰斯頓接觸。威爾斯是整場對峙中最具實務能力的人，他主持修築堡壘線，堅持不在開闊地交戰，最後同意解散民兵並繳出砲械。亨利·謝爾伍德接管防務後，把堡壘線經營成一個完整體系；以色列·卡特勒、艾薩克·切斯與約瑟夫·查德威克分別控制民兵編制、鹽湖城守備與前線據點；軍需官邁爾斯·古德耶則在鹽湖城集中大批火砲與彈藥，供應修築工事。
peopleEn: On the federal side the driving figure was President James Buchanan, who ordered the expedition on the ground that the Mormon question endangered the security of the western territories, and who suspended the writ of habeas corpus in Utah, tying the movement of troops to federal jurisdiction so that the march would look like the enforcement of law rather than an invasion. The first commander was Colonel James H. Carleton, who led the long advance of 1857 and the crossing of the Great Salt Lake desert, and who was relieved in the spring of 1858 for his conduct of command and his mishandling of supply. Major General Albert Sidney Johnston took over in March 1858, steadied the position through that year and directed the expedition of 1859, and was finally killed at Shiloh. The California and Nevada mounted volunteers were drawn from merchants and town populations, uneven in discipline and divided in politics, and both Carleton and his successors spent a good deal of effort keeping them in hand. The centre of gravity in Utah was Brigham Young, who governed as territorial governor and church president at once, and who managed the crisis by putting successors in place before withdrawing: having at first refused the order of expulsion issued in April 1858, he nevertheless left Salt Lake City in May for the Missouri River and handed the negotiation to his lieutenant general, Daniel H. Wells. Wells was the most practically capable man in the whole confrontation, overseeing the building of the fortification line, insisting that no general action be fought in the open, and finally agreeing to disband the militia and surrender the guns. Henry G. Sherwood took over the defences and turned the earthworks into a complete system; Israel Cutler, Isaac Chase and Joseph Chadwick controlled the militia organisation, the garrison of Salt Lake City and the forward posts respectively, while the quartermaster Miles Goodyear concentrated a large store of cannon and ammunition in Salt Lake City to equip the works.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是線膛砲，即一八五〇年代口徑裝填的野戰砲。技術要點在砲膛內壁刻出螺旋膛線，讓同樣藥量在膛線約束下取得更平直的彈道，射程因此延伸，砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步兵。克里米亞戰爭之後歐洲各國競相試驗，普魯士的六磅線膛野戰砲在一八五〇年代中期定型，英國阿姆斯特朗砲於一八五八年問世，美國的達爾格倫線膛砲則要到一八六〇年前後才真正進入軍備序列。放到這場戰爭裡看，這門砲屬於剛好還沒到位的裝備。聯邦遠征軍的砲兵連在一八五七至一八五八年間裝備的仍是滑膛銅砲，以一八五七年型六磅與十二磅野戰砲為主，另有少量老舊四磅砲；猶他堡壘線上的八十八門砲同樣以滑膛為主，包括黃銅六磅、十二磅野戰砲、二十四磅攻城砲與數門山砲，另有摩門手推車公司自堪薩斯城用手推車與騾牛運來的一批軍械。戰役全期沒有任何一次交火是由線膛砲的射程優勢決定：砲兵的工作是封鎖道路、掩護進攻、壓制對面砲火，而左右局勢的始終是堡壘的牆、工事的進度與補給線上的牛車。除線膛砲外，聯邦步兵大量使用一八五五年型春田步槍，膛徑零點五八吋，各州團屬仍配一八四一年密西西比長槍；騎兵用科爾特轉輪手槍與後裝馬槍，砲兵另有少量騎乘臼砲。摩門民兵則以獵槍、來福槍與少量騎槍為主，每名民兵自備馬匹、口糧與彈藥。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the rifled muzzle-loading field gun, the field piece of the 1850s. Its point is the spiral groove cut into the bore, which constrains the same powder charge into a flatter trajectory, extends the range, and for the first time lets artillery out-range infantry. After the Crimean War every European power competed to develop the idea: the Prussian six-pounder rifled field gun was settled by the middle of the 1850s, Armstrong's gun appeared in Britain in 1858, and the American Dahlgren rifled gun did not really enter service until around 1860. Seen from the standpoint of this war, the piece belongs to the equipment that had just not yet arrived. The artillery companies of the federal expedition in 1857 and 1858 were still armed with smoothbore bronze guns, principally the 1857-pattern six- and twelve-pounder field pieces with a few obsolete four-pounders; the eighty-eight guns on the Utah fortification line were smoothbore as well, including brass six- and twelve-pounders, twenty-four-pounder siege pieces and several mountain howitzers, together with a consignment of ordnance that the Mormon handcart company hauled by handcart and mule from Kansas City. No engagement in the whole campaign was decided by the range advantage of a rifled gun: the guns were there to close roads, cover advances and silence opposing batteries, and what actually settled the situation was always the wall of the fort, the progress of the works, and the ox-carts of the supply line. Besides the rifled gun, federal infantry used the 1855-pattern Springfield musket in .58 calibre extensively, with state regiments still carrying the 1841 Mississippi rifle; cavalry had Colt revolvers and percussion carbines, and the artillery a few mounted howitzers. The Mormon militia relied on hunting rifles, cheap rifled long guns and a few cavalry pieces, each man providing his own horse, rations and ammunition.
tactics: 這場戰爭沒有會戰，雙方爭的是誰先動。聯邦軍採三路並進：主力由約翰斯頓率領，自拉勒米堡與布里傑堡，經熊河山口進入谷地東端；車隊自堪薩斯城經布賴傑堡轉運，全程約一千三百英里；另有一支由加利福尼亞騎兵義勇隊組成的支隊越過內華達山脈，由卡森河與強生山口南下，於一八五七年十一月進入谷地西南端，與主力呈南北夾擊之勢。摩門方面的對策是拒絕在開闊地交戰：民兵撤回谷地北緣與瓦薩奇山脈山腳一線，修築約十英里胸牆、四百座碉堡小屋與八十八門砲的堡壘線；把農地與草場一律燒掉，令聯邦軍馬匹無草可食；扼住艾可峽谷與各處山口；用散兵與游擊隊騷擾聯邦前哨；並且拒絕任何一次主動出擊。全役唯一較有規模的炮擊是一八五八年三月聯邦軍炮擊「猶他堡」並將其攻下；此後兩軍隔谷對峙，聯邦軍在艾可峽谷掘壕固守、備妥攻擊陣勢，猶他民兵則靠壘線與後方存糧硬撐，直到談判完成。
tacticsEn: This war had no general engagement; what the two sides fought over was who would move first. The federal column advanced on three axes. The main body under Johnston came by way of Fort Laramie and Fort Bridger, crossed Bear River Pass and entered the eastern end of the valley; the wagon trains were turned over at Fort Bridger from the handcart route out of Kansas City, about 1,300 miles in all; and a third force, the California mounted volunteers, crossed the Sierra Nevada, came down by the Carson River and Johnson Pass, and entered the south-western end of the valley in November 1857, presenting a pincer from north and south. The Mormon answer was to refuse a battle in the open. The militia withdrew to a line along the northern edge of the Great Salt Lake and the foot of the Wasatch Range, where they raised some ten miles of breastwork, four hundred blockhouse cabins and a battery of eighty-eight guns. They burned the standing crops and grass so that the federal horses and mules would go unfed, held the passes at Echo Canyon and elsewhere, harassed federal pickets with skirmishers and mounted patrols, and refused to initiate a single major action. The only substantial exchange of artillery fire was the federal bombardment of Fort Utah in March 1858, which carried the fort. After that the two armies faced one another across the valley, the federal troops digging in at Echo Canyon and preparing a storming party, and the Utah militia holding on behind earthworks and stored grain until the negotiations were concluded.
data: 兵力方面，聯邦遠征軍約二千五百名正規軍，加州與內華達騎兵義勇隊約七百五十人，連同後勤與隨軍人員在三千五百上下；猶他民兵編為約九十個連，總數約二千五百人，各家紀錄略有出入。一八五八年春聯邦軍抵達堡壘線時，約翰斯頓把騎兵與砲兵擺在艾可峽谷與北面缺口，步兵不再往南推進。距離方面，聯邦陸路自拉勒米堡到鹽湖城約八百英里，手推車公司的路線自堪薩斯城算起約一千三百英里，單程需時四到五個月；一八五七年秋至一八五八年春的運補線屢遭肖肖尼與派尤特戰士襲擊，牛、騾與車輛損失以數百計，加州騎兵支隊在高山冬季缺飼料，亦損失數百匹馬匹。堡壘線的工程量約為十英里胸牆、四百座碉堡小屋、八十八門砲。全役時間自一八五七年四月至一八五八年七月，前後約十五個月，其中真正對峙的階段約五個月，聯邦軍進入鹽湖城是一八五八年七月二十六日。損失方面，聯邦軍的戰鬥死亡極少，各家說法多不超過二十人，疾病、意外與騎兵走失造成的減員遠多於此；一八五八年三月攻打「猶他堡」的短促交火是全役唯一有實質炮擊的戰鬥，聯邦軍付出數人死傷即佔領該堡。
dataEn: On strength: the federal expedition counted about 2,500 regulars, with some 750 California and Nevada mounted volunteers and roughly 3,500 men in all once rear-echelon and service troops are added; the Utah militia was organised into some ninety companies with a total of about 2,500 men, figures that vary slightly from source to source. When the federal army reached the fortification line in the spring of 1858, Johnston placed his cavalry and guns at Echo Canyon and the northern gap and declined to push his infantry further south. On distance: the overland federal route ran about 800 miles from Fort Laramie to Salt Lake City, and the handcart company's line about 1,300 miles from Kansas City, taking four to five months one way. The supply line was raided by Shoshone and Paiute war parties through the autumn of 1857 and the winter of 1858, and hundreds of cattle, mules and wagons were lost, while the California column, cut off from forage in the high country, also lost several hundred horses. The works themselves amounted to some ten miles of breastwork, four hundred blockhouse cabins and eighty-eight guns. In time, the war ran from April 1857 to July 1858, about fifteen months, of which roughly five were the standoff itself, the federal entry into Salt Lake City coming on 26 July 1858. On losses: federal battle deaths were very few, most accounts putting them at no more than twenty, and disease, accident and lost horses removed far more men than combat did. The brief action against Fort Utah in March 1858 was the only engagement in the campaign involving real artillery fire, and the fort fell at a cost of a handful of federal casualties.
cause: 直接導火線是聯邦與摩門政權在猶他領地的一連串法律衝突。一八五〇年領地成立時，聯邦任命的官員與教會主導的立法機關互不相讓；一八五五年，領地議會通過一系列禁止重婚、限制非摩門選民投票的法令，聯邦司法當局認定其違憲並拒絕承認，雙方的對立因此從選舉與土地問題上升為根本的管轄權之爭；一八五六年摩門議會又拒絕執行聯邦法官的裁定，並武裝了一批教區民兵。在此背景下，總統布坎南於一八五七年四月調兵，理由是領地政府已無力維持秩序、無法保障聯邦公民，也無法驅逐原住民部落的侵擾。一八五七年九月，聯邦公民組成的移民車隊在布賴傑堡外遭到摩門民兵攻擊，夜襲與迫降之後，此事在全國引起轟動，輿論要求加派兵員，教方則為民兵行動辯護；遠征軍規模因此由原定不足三千人擴大，並有大量自願騎兵從加利福尼亞與內華達加入。原本可以談判解決的僵局，就此被推成全面衝突。
causeEn: The immediate occasion was a running series of legal collisions between the federal government and the Mormon authorities in Utah. When the territory was created in 1850, federally appointed officials and the church-dominated legislature were never able to work together. In 1855 the territorial assembly passed a series of acts forbidding polygamy and restricting the vote to church members; the federal judiciary declared them unconstitutional and refused to recognise them, and what had begun as a quarrel over elections and land hardened into a contest over jurisdiction. In 1856 the assembly again refused to enforce a federal judge's ruling and armed a body of ward militia. Against that background President Buchanan ordered troops in April 1857 on the ground that the territorial government could no longer keep order, protect federal citizens or repel the incursions of the native tribes. In September 1857 a column of federal citizens was attacked by Mormon militia outside Fort Bridger, and after the night action and the surrender of the camp the story carried across the country: public opinion demanded more troops, and the Church defended the conduct of its men. The expedition was accordingly enlarged beyond the three thousand originally planned, and large numbers of mounted volunteers joined from California and Nevada. A standoff that might have been settled by negotiation was thereby pushed into open war.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果是聯邦的實際勝利、摩門教在政治上的重大挫敗：鹽湖城的領地政府被改組，布賴翰·楊離開後由約翰·蓋爾西出任總督，聯邦常備軍進駐，並在谷地北面興建佛利德與道格拉斯等營地，教會在鹽湖城內的實際行政權被削弱。然而教會的制度與經濟根基並未被摧毀，它仍控制著大部分定居點的互助組織、水利與教育，重婚問題也完全沒有解決。一八五〇年代後半的「摩門問題」因此從邊陲爭議升格為全國議題，一八六二年國會通過反重婚法，一八六〇年代聯邦對摩門領地的主權衝突再起，一八九〇年教會終於以宣言放棄重婚，兩萬餘名「廢約者」陸續西遷。戰爭本身的開支以百萬美元計，遠征軍的物資全靠手推車運到最遠，聯邦政府為此立下遠距西部補給成本高昂的先例；此役也讓聯邦確認，可以用少量常備軍加志願兵在沒有會戰的情況下結束西部領地的抵抗，此後阿拉斯加與西南部領地的問題都沿用了同一套模式。
impactEn: The outcome of the war was a practical victory for the federal government and a serious political reverse for the Church. The territorial government at Salt Lake City was reorganised; after Brigham Young's departure John W. Geary took office as governor; federal troops were garrisoned in the valley and camps such as Floyd's and Douglas's were established along its northern side; and the effective administrative authority of the Church inside the city was curtailed. The institutional and economic base of the Church, however, was not destroyed. It still controlled most of the mutual-aid organisation, irrigation and education in the settlements, and the question of polygamy was in no way resolved. The Mormon question of the late 1850s was thereby lifted from a frontier grievance to a national issue: Congress passed anti-bigamy legislation in 1862, the federal contest for authority in the territory revived through the 1860s, and in 1890 the Church renounced polygamy by manifesto, sending more than twenty thousand polygamists into exile in the West. The war itself cost the government millions of dollars, since the expedition's supplies were handcarted to the far end of the line, and it set the precedent that feeding the far western territories cost a great deal of money. It also established that a small regular force, reinforced by volunteers, could end resistance in the western territories without a general battle, a pattern followed later in Alaska and the south-west.
result: 結局是雙方都沒有戰勝對方：聯邦軍未能在任何一場戰鬥中擊潰摩門民兵，摩門方面也未能驅走遠征軍。一八五八年三月聯邦軍攻下「猶他堡」之後，兩軍在艾可峽谷與堡壘線之間對峙數月，聯邦軍掘壕固守、備妥強攻，摩門民兵則靠壘線與後方存糧硬撐。真正的轉折是聯邦對布賴翰·楊下達的離境令與此後的談判：一八五八年五月楊離開鹽湖城，摩門當局同意解散民兵、封存砲械並允許聯邦軍入城；同年七月二十六日，約翰斯頓率軍進入鹽湖城，沒有開一槍。堡壘線隨即拆除，聯邦法庭在猶他恢復運作，約翰·蓋爾西以新總督身分接管行政。戰爭到此結束，但背後的爭議一場也沒有解決：重婚照舊，聯邦對教會的疑慮照舊，而這場沒有流血的遠征，日後在美國內戰的歷史裡反而被雙方各自拿來引證。
resultEn: The end was a victory for neither side: the federal army never broke the Mormon militia in a single action, and the Mormons never drove the expedition out. After the fall of Fort Utah in March 1858 the two forces faced one another for months at Echo Canyon and along the works, the federal troops digging in and preparing a storm, the Utah militia holding on behind earthworks and stored grain. The turning point was the order of expulsion served on Brigham Young and the negotiations that followed. In May 1858 Young left Salt Lake City, the Utah authorities agreed to disband their militia, to seal up their guns and to let federal troops into the city, and on 26 July of the same year Johnston marched in without firing a shot. The fortification line was dismantled, federal courts resumed their business in Utah, and John W. Geary took over the administration as governor. There the war ended, but not one of the disputes behind it was settled: polygamy continued, the federal suspicion of the Church continued, and this bloodless expedition was later cited, on both sides, in the histories of the American Civil War.
